items.title: How much does each spaced review add to retention?
items.description: Using the same illustrative numbers as L3 (no review leaves about 10% retention by test day, each well-timed spaced review adds roughly 16 points, capped at 95%), drag the number of spaced reviews to see retention on test day change. At 0 reviews, this reproduces Maya's actual result; at 5, it reproduces Diego's.
